entries.zh-CN: 工作流的智能体节点可以持续等待耗时很长的任务。
entries.en-US: Agent nodes in workflows can keep waiting for long-running tasks.

entries.zh-CN: 可以设置循环达到次数上限后的处理方式，条件判断支持变量模板。
entries.en-US: You can choose what happens when a loop reaches its limit, and conditions accept variable templates.

entries.zh-CN: 智能体没有登录时会明确提示，变量列表为空时也会说明原因。
entries.en-US: Ora says clearly when an agent is not signed in, and explains an empty variable list.

entries.zh-CN: 智能体输出内容时，界面其他部分更流畅。
entries.en-US: The rest of the app stays responsive while an agent is writing.

entries.zh-CN: 修复断电后项目、任务和工作树可能丢失的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed projects, tasks, and worktrees being lost after a power failure.

entries.zh-CN: 修复打开第二个 Ora 窗口进程时，正在运行的工作流被中断的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed running workflows being interrupted when a second Ora process started.

entries.zh-CN: 修复内容异常的工作流打开后白屏的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed a blank screen when opening a damaged workflow.

entries.zh-CN: 修复工作流节点拖动不跟手、卡顿的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed workflow nodes lagging behind while being dragged.

entries.zh-CN: 修复任务草稿会在主工作区启动会话的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed task drafts starting sessions in the main workspace.

entries.zh-CN: 修复“添加来源”没有打开市场配置的问题，插件源更新会使用为它设置的代理。
entries.en-US: Fixed “Add source” not opening the marketplace settings; plugin sources now update through their configured proxy.

entries.zh-CN: 修复工作流顶栏描述和对话框标题过长时的显示问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed overlong workflow descriptions and dialog titles.
